title: 568. Relative Ranks

examples.explanation: The best score 5 earns gold, then 4 silver, 3 bronze, and the rest keep their numeric ranks.
Sorted best-first the scores are 10, 9, 8, 4, 3, giving ranks 1..5 mapped back to the input order.

hints: Sort competitor indices by score from high to low; the position in that order is the rank.
Translate ranks 1, 2, 3 to the three medal names and format all other ranks as decimal strings.
